import os, sys
from pathlib import Path

PID = Path('{{pid_path}}')
if PID.exists():
    old = int(PID.read_text())
    try:
        os.kill(old, 0)
        print(f'already running pid {old}'); sys.exit(1)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        pass
PID.write_text(str(os.getpid()))
try:
    print('running'); import time; time.sleep(60)
finally:
    PID.unlink(missing_ok=True)
